name: stepfun-asr
description: Transcribe audio with StepFun's stepaudio-3-asr-max — an SSE endpoint (NOT /v1/audio/transcriptions), single call handles long audio with no client-side chunking. Use when transcribing Chinese / English audio with StepFun, when long-form recordings (5-30 min) need to land in one request, when migrating from step-asr / step-asr-1.1 / stepaudio-2.5-asr, or when hitting the misleading `model stepaudio-3-asr-max not supported` error (which actually means wrong endpoint). Triggers on 阶跃 ASR, StepFun
author: daymade
